title: Slipr show
description: A Slipr show (show.json), format version 0.2 (0.1 is still valid). Spec: docs/show-format.md

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editor autocomplete.

slipr.description: Show format version. 0.2 adds slide overlays (extra images and text elements), graph, map, table, tag cloud and video slots and blocks, picture style / opacity and glossary aliases; a 0.1 show without them is still valid.

glossary.description: Glossary terms by id. Referenced in Markdown as [[id]] or [[id|text]].

profiles.description: Reader profiles that blocks can be targeted at with 'for'.

paths.description: Curated routes through the show for reader mode.

id.description: Identifier: letters, digits, '-' and '_', starting with a letter or digit.

language.description: BCP-47 language tag, e.g. en or nl-NL.

ref.description: Path or URL of the template folder, relative to show.json.

version.description: Semver range the show was made for, e.g. ^1.0.

agenda.description: Audience mode: insert a generated agenda slide before each chapter.

aliases.description: (0.2) Other names for the term (plurals, abbreviations, synonyms), matched like the term in reader-mode slides (I-086).

slides.description: Slide ids in order, or "*" for all slides.

content.description: Audience layer: slot name -> slot value. Slot types come from the template layout.

overlays.description: Extra images (D-013) and text elements (D-016) placed freely on the slide, in front of the layout (format 0.2). Later ones are in front.

_orphaned.description: Editor-internal: slot values kept after a layout switch, restored when switching back.

cards.description: Value of a 'cards' slot: one object per card. Field names and types come from the template's slot definition.

overlay.description: An extra image (D-013) or a text element (D-016) on a slide: either `image` or `text`. Position and size are fractions of the slide canvas.

text.description: A text element (I-089): inline Markdown, lines separated by \n.

x.description: Left edge, fraction of the canvas width.

y.description: Top edge, fraction of the canvas height.

w.description: Width, fraction of the canvas width.

h.description: Height, fraction of the canvas height.

fragment.description: Appear one by one in audience mode; true or a Reveal fragment style.

textStyle.description: The look of a text element (D-016, I-089). Lengths are percentages of the slide width. Absent = the template's look for slide text.

font.description: The template's heading / body / code (mono) font, or a platform font.

size.description: Font size: a percentage of the slide width, or the template's size for a kind of text.

style.description: (0.2) Id of one of the template's picture styles (D-014).

opacity.description: (0.2) Opacity of the picture, 0-1; absent means 1.

morphId.description: (0.2) Pairs this picture with the picture of the same name on the next or previous auto-animate slide, so it morphs (I-091).

imageCrop.description: (0.2) The part of the picture that is shown (I-090), as fractions of the picture. Hotspots stay positions on the whole picture.

x.description: Left edge, fraction of the picture's width.

y.description: Top edge, fraction of the picture's height.

w.description: Width, fraction of the picture's width.

h.description: Height, fraction of the picture's height.

web.description: (0.2) A web page on a slide (slot type 'web', I-071).

url.description: Absolute https URL, or path relative to show.json.

present.description: Audience mode: "live" (default) loads the page on the slide; "static" shows the fallback image.

load.description: Reader mode, a page on another server: "click" (default) waits for the reader's consent, "auto" loads straight away (D-011).

fallback.description: Screenshot shown for print, thumbnails, offline presenting and instead of the link card.

pdf.description: (0.2) A PDF document on a slide (slot type 'pdf', I-072).
The PDF: a path relative to show.json, or an https URL (the server must allow CORS).

load.description: Reader mode, a PDF on another server: "click" (default) waits for the reader's consent, "auto" loads straight away (D-011).

fallback.description: Static image shown for print, thumbnails and when the PDF cannot be shown.

video.description: (0.2) A video on a slide (slot type 'video', I-110).
A path relative to show.json (e.g. media/clip.mp4), a YouTube or Vimeo link, or an https link to a video file.

end.description: Stop at this time (seconds). Not for Vimeo.

play.description: Audience mode: "click" (default) the presenter presses play, "slide" plays when the slide appears, "step" on the next click.

chapterSteps.description: Audience mode: every further chapter is a step (each click jumps to it).

transcript.description: Markdown transcript, shown in reader mode and found by search.

present.description: Audience mode: "live" (default) plays the video; "static" shows the poster only.

load.description: Reader mode, a video on another server: "click" (default) waits for the reader's consent, "auto" loads straight away (D-011).

fallback.description: The poster: shown before playing, for print, thumbnails, static presenting and while waiting for Load.

videoCaptions.description: (0.2) Captions for a video file: a WebVTT file in the show folder.

videoChapters.description: (0.2) Chapters of a video: a time (seconds) and a title each.

pdfPages.description: (0.2) First and last page (inclusive). Audience mode steps through them on clicks; reader mode limits page navigation to them.

webAllow.description: (0.2) Extra sandbox permissions for an embedded page (I-071). same-origin applies to pages on other servers only.

graph.description: (0.2) A graph of nodes and edges, drawn with Cytoscape.js (I-074). Needs nodes or a data file.

nodes.description: The nodes: id (unique), label, tags (the first picks a template color), md (shown when selected), slide (a link to that slide).

data.description: A JSON file in the show folder with { nodes, edges }; inline entries come after the file's.

steps.description: Audience mode, slots only: one per click; show more nodes, or focus one with its neighbours.

fallback.description: Static image shown for print, thumbnails and when rendering fails (I-070).

graphStep.description: Show more nodes, or focus one node (zoom to it and its neighbours).

table.description: (0.2) A data table from a CSV file or inline rows (I-104): sorting, filter, totals, colours, row steps. Needs rows, columns or a data file.

data.description: A CSV file in the show folder (comma, semicolon or tab separated; the first line holds the column keys).

columns.description: Column settings by key: they define inline columns, and configure (and order) a file's columns.

rows.description: Instead of data: the rows inline, each an array of cells in the order of columns.

sortable.description: Click a header to sort (ascending, descending, original order).

filter.description: A search box that keeps the rows containing the text.

maxRows.description: Rows visible before the table scrolls (the header stays in place).

pinFirst.description: The first shown column stays in place while the table scrolls sideways.

locale.description: Number and date formatting (e.g. nl-NL); default the show's meta.language.

steps.description: Audience mode, slots only: one per click; show the first n rows, or highlight a row, a column or a cell.

fallback.description: Static image shown for print, thumbnails and when rendering fails (I-070).

tagCloud.description: (0.2) A tag cloud from inline terms or a CSV file (I-105): terms sized by weight, linked to the glossary, reveal and highlight steps. Needs terms or a data file.

data.description: A CSV file in the show folder: a term column and an optional weight column (the first line holds the headers).

terms.description: Instead of data: the terms inline. Repeated terms are merged and their weights add up.

termColumn.description: The CSV column with the terms; default the first column.

weightColumn.description: The CSV column with the weights; default the second column when it holds numbers, else every row counts 1.

order.description: cloud (default): the heaviest terms in the middle; weight: heaviest first; alphabetical; none: as written.

maxTerms.description: Show only the heaviest n terms.

weightLabel.description: What a weight counts, e.g. mentions: readers see '12 mentions' (default 'weight 12').

steps.description: Audience mode, slots only: one per click; show the heaviest n terms, or highlight terms.

fallback.description: Static image shown for print, thumbnails and when rendering fails (I-070).

text.description: The term; an empty one is not shown.

weight.description: Size by weight or frequency; default 1.

glossary.description: Glossary id; default: the glossary term (or alias) with the same name.

highlight.description: Highlight a term (or several) until the next step; null clears.

key.description: The CSV header, or the inline column's name.

format.description: Default: number when every filled cell is a number (shown as written), else text.

currency.description: ISO currency code for format currency; default EUR.

hidden.description: Not shown; readers can show it from the Columns menu.

total.description: A footer value over the rows on show.

visual.description: Numeric columns: colour scale, data bar, or negative / positive colours.

rows.description: Show the first n rows (data order).

row.description: Row number (1-based, data order) or the first column's text.

highlight.description: Highlight a row, a column or a cell until the next step; null clears.

map.description: (0.2) An interactive map drawn with Leaflet (I-075). Needs a center, markers or layers.

center.description: The view's center; without it the view fits the markers and layers.

zoom.description: Zoom level (0 = the world, about 18 = a street); with no center, the most the fitted view zooms in.

markers.description: Places: lat, lng, title, md (shown when selected), tags (the first picks a template color), slide (a link to that slide), id (for steps).

layers.description: GeoJSON files in the show folder, drawn in their tag's color.

load.description: Reader mode, tiles from a server: "click" (default) waits for the reader's consent, "auto" loads straight away (D-011).

fallback.description: Static image shown for print, thumbnails, offline presenting and when the map cannot be drawn (I-070).

steps.description: Audience mode, slots only: one per click, fly to a marker (by id) at a zoom level.

present.description: Audience mode: "live" (default) loads tiles from a server on the slide; "static" shows the fallback (image, or the list of places).

data.description: A GeoJSON file in the show folder (.geojson or .json).

tag.description: Picks the layer's template color, like a marker's first tag. Without a tag the layer is background (land, borders): drawn in neutral colors, and left out of the fitted first view.

mapTiles.description: The background map: an https URL template with {z}, {x} and {y} (default OpenStreetMap), a template relative to show.json for tiles in the show folder, "none", or { url, attribution, maxZoom }.

attribution.description: Plain text, shown on the map as the tile provider asks.

fallback.description: (0.2) Static image shown for print, thumbnails and when rendering fails (I-070).

hidden.description: Backup slide: skipped while presenting, reachable via the overview.

fragments.description: Reveal list items one by one; true or a Reveal fragment style.

autoAnimate.description: Morph matching elements into the next/previous auto-animate slide.

background.description: CSS color or image path (relative to show.json).

hidden.description: Leave this slide out of reader mode.

showSlide.description: Show the slide visual above the blocks (default true).

block.description: Reader block; the 'type' field selects the block kind.

for.description: Profile ids that see this block; absent = everyone.

url.description: Absolute URL, or path relative to show.json.

aspect.description: (0.2) Width:height, e.g. 16:9; the frame scales with the column. Wins over height (I-071).

load.description: (0.2) A page on another server: "click" (default) waits for the reader's consent, "auto" loads straight away (D-011).

fallback.description: (0.2) Static image shown for print, thumbnails and instead of the link card (I-070).
(0.2) Static image shown for print, thumbnails and when rendering fails (I-070).

blockGraph.description: (0.2) A graph in the reader layer (I-074): pan, zoom, select a node, filter by tag.

nodes.description: The nodes: id (unique), label, tags (the first picks a template color), md (shown when selected), slide (a link to that slide).

data.description: A JSON file in the show folder with { nodes, edges }; inline entries come after the file's.

fallback.description: Static image shown for print, thumbnails and when rendering fails (I-070).

blockTable.description: (0.2) A data table in the reader layer (I-104): sorting, filter, columns, copy and download.

data.description: A CSV file in the show folder (comma, semicolon or tab separated; the first line holds the column keys).

columns.description: Column settings by key: they define inline columns, and configure (and order) a file's columns.

rows.description: Instead of data: the rows inline, each an array of cells in the order of columns.

sortable.description: Click a header to sort (ascending, descending, original order).

filter.description: A search box that keeps the rows containing the text.

maxRows.description: Rows visible before the table scrolls (the header stays in place).

pinFirst.description: The first shown column stays in place while the table scrolls sideways.

locale.description: Number and date formatting (e.g. nl-NL); default the show's meta.language.

fallback.description: Static image shown for print, thumbnails and when rendering fails (I-070).

blockTagCloud.description: (0.2) A tag cloud in the reader layer (I-105): each term opens its glossary definition and the slides that mention it.

data.description: A CSV file in the show folder: a term column and an optional weight column (the first line holds the headers).

terms.description: Instead of data: the terms inline. Repeated terms are merged and their weights add up.

termColumn.description: The CSV column with the terms; default the first column.

weightColumn.description: The CSV column with the weights; default the second column when it holds numbers, else every row counts 1.

order.description: cloud (default): the heaviest terms in the middle; weight: heaviest first; alphabetical; none: as written.

maxTerms.description: Show only the heaviest n terms.

weightLabel.description: What a weight counts, e.g. mentions: readers see '12 mentions' (default 'weight 12').

fallback.description: Static image shown for print, thumbnails and when rendering fails (I-070).

blockMap.description: (0.2) A map in the reader layer (I-075): pan, zoom, select a place, filter by tag.

center.description: The view's center; without it the view fits the markers and layers.

zoom.description: Zoom level (0 = the world, about 18 = a street); with no center, the most the fitted view zooms in.

markers.description: Places: lat, lng, title, md (shown when selected), tags (the first picks a template color), slide (a link to that slide), id (for steps).

layers.description: GeoJSON files in the show folder, drawn in their tag's color.

load.description: Reader mode, tiles from a server: "click" (default) waits for the reader's consent, "auto" loads straight away (D-011).

fallback.description: Static image shown for print, thumbnails, offline presenting and when the map cannot be drawn (I-070).

blockPdf.description: (0.2) A PDF document in the reader layer (I-072).

pdf.description: A path relative to show.json, or an https URL (the server must allow CORS).

blockVideo.description: (0.2) A video in the reader layer (I-110).

video.description: A path relative to show.json (e.g. media/clip.mp4), a YouTube or Vimeo link, or an https link to a video file.

end.description: Stop at this time (seconds). Not for Vimeo.

transcript.description: Markdown transcript, shown in reader mode and found by search.

load.description: Reader mode, a video on another server: "click" (default) waits for the reader's consent, "auto" loads straight away (D-011).

fallback.description: The poster: shown before playing, for print, thumbnails, static presenting and while waiting for Load.
